name: Don Robertson
story: Don Robertson was NIWA’s General Manager, Biodiversity, Biosecurity and Information Systems when he and Hamilton-based researcher Mary de Winton described the Freshwater Biodata Information System in September 2004. Their published account explained how the web service joined older freshwater biological records with searches by organism, catchment, river reach and mapped area. It also set out plans for the wider Freshwater Information New Zealand system, which remained under development.
